A young man with a mystical aura.
Somehow his looks and aura resemble [url=/c83402]Misyr Rex[/url]'s.
He appears before the protagonist with no warning and makes contact with her.
[spoiler]His original name is Noah, additionally he is also known as the World of End Times.[/spoiler]
